For a 50-person Indian company, OfficeKit HR is more of an HRMS with travel-management functionality than a dedicated travel-management company. Here’s the practical comparison:

Option	Current price	Exclusions / watch-outs	Best for
OfficeKit HR Platinum	₹7,500/month listed starting price*	Travel is one HRMS module; actual booking/service costs and partner charges are separate.	Companies wanting HR + travel in one system
ITILITE	$10/trip (~₹840) or $7/trip with wallet; expense module $6/user/month annually	Extras such as seat ₹50, meal ₹50, post-booking baggage ₹50 unless contracted. 
Itilite
+1
	50-person tech/startup wanting automated travel + expenses
MakeMyTrip myBiz	Custom service fee; booking fare + GST; 1.5% payment-gateway fee can apply	Service fee varies by contract; strongest around flights/hotels rather than deep HR workflows. 
MakeMyTrip
+1
	India-heavy travel with easy employee booking
FCM Travel	Custom quote	Enterprise/TMC model; pricing isn't publicly listed.	Companies needing 24/7 human support, international travel and duty-of-care 
FCM Travel
+1

*Third-party listing; OfficeKit's current site says pricing is tailored by headcount/modules. 
officekithr.com
+1

Key distinction: OfficeKit is HR-first; ITILITE is travel/expense-tech-first; myBiz is booking-first; FCM is full-service TMC-first.
